title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
author: Stephen R. Covey
summary: Stephen Covey presents seven habits for personal and professional effectiveness, built on character and principles rather than quick tricks. They include being proactive, beginning with the end in mind and putting first things first.
readIf: you like structured self-improvement frameworks you can apply to work and family.
skipIf: you find motivational frameworks repetitive or prefer evidence-heavy psychology.
